relationships.subject: miR-30 family
relationships.evidence_quote: Our analysis showed correlations between expression values of NEDD4, miR-30a-5p (r = 0.52) and miR-30d-5p (r = 0.5)

relationships.subject: NEDD4
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, it negatively correlated with NEDD4 expression and both members of miR-30 family

key_findings: Four miRNAs (miR-30a-5p, miR-30d-5p, miR-181a-2-3p, miR-203a-3p) are downregulated in epidermis of SCN9A gain-of-function painful neuropathy patients.
Nav1.7 immunoreactivity is increased in patient keratinocytes and negatively correlates with NEDD4 and miR-30 family expression.
